info.brief: A stylized water shader: animated wave surfaces, foam, sparkles, refraction and
info.description:
A stylized water shader: animated wave surfaces, foam, sparkles, refraction and
reflection, set through shader constants. A game object script calls `init` once with
the camera, sun and water objects, then `update(dt)` and `update_camera()` every frame.
The render script calls `render_init(self)` at the end of its `init` and
`render_update(self, state, predicates, draw_options_world)` in its `update` (see
`water/render/water.render_script`). The shader needs `exclude_gles_sm100 = 1` under
`[shader]` in `game.project`. Every setter writes a shader constant the next
`render_update` uploads, and every getter returns the stored values as separate
values.

elements.name: init
elements.brief: Stores the camera, sun and water objects and the time speed, then reads the camera
elements.description:
Stores the camera, sun and water objects and the time speed, then reads the camera
position and near and far planes and the sun direction once. Call it from a game
object script's `init`.

parameters.name: camera_url
parameters.doc: The camera game object, whose world position the shader uses.

parameters.name: camera_component_url
parameters.doc: The camera component, whose near and far Z planes the shader uses.

parameters.name: sun_url
parameters.doc: The sun game object, whose position sets the light and the sun direction.

parameters.name: water_url
parameters.doc: The water surface game object, the origin of the sun direction.

parameters.name: time_speed
parameters.doc: The multiplier `update` applies to `dt` to advance the wave time.

elements.name: render_init
elements.brief: Adds the `water` predicate to `self.predicates`, creates the scene render target at
elements.description:
Adds the `water` predicate to `self.predicates`, creates the scene render target at
`self.state.width` by `self.state.height` with a color and a depth buffer, and
creates the two constant buffers `render_update` draws with, all stored on `self`.
Call it at the end of the render script's `init`, once `self.predicates` and
`self.state` are set.

parameters.name: self
parameters.doc: The render script instance.

elements.name: render_update
elements.brief: Draws the `model` predicate into the scene render target, then draws `model` and the
elements.description:
Draws the `model` predicate into the scene render target, then draws `model` and the
water to the default render target, sampling the scene's depth and color for edge
foam and refraction. It needs `render_init` to have run on the same `self`, and
raises otherwise. Call it from the render script's `update` after the world view and
projection are set.

parameters.name: self
parameters.doc: The render script instance `render_init` ran on.

parameters.name: state
parameters.doc: The render state: the window size and the clear values.

parameters.name: predicates
parameters.doc:
The render script's predicates; pass `self.predicates`, which holds
the `water` predicate `render_init` added.

parameters.name: draw_options_world
parameters.doc: The draw options for the world, used for the scene pass.

elements.name: update_sun
elements.brief: Re-reads the sun position, which moves the light and recomputes the sun direction
elements.description:
Re-reads the sun position, which moves the light and recomputes the sun direction
from the water object, replacing any direction `set_sun_direction` wrote.

elements.name: update_camera
elements.brief: Re-reads the camera world position and its near and far Z planes. Call it every frame.
elements.description: Re-reads the camera world position and its near and far Z planes. Call it every frame.

elements.name: update
elements.brief: Advances the wave time by `dt` times the time speed `init` stored, unless the timer
elements.description:
Advances the wave time by `dt` times the time speed `init` stored, unless the timer
is paused. Call it every frame.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The frame time in seconds.

elements.name: pause
elements.brief: Pauses or resumes the wave timer.
elements.description: Pauses or resumes the wave timer.

parameters.name: state
parameters.doc: `true` stops the timer, `false` resumes it.

elements.name: set_wave1
elements.brief: Sets the first wave layer.
elements.description: Sets the first wave layer.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.doc: The wave direction in radians, `0` to `2π`: `0` east, `π/2` north, `π` west, `3π/2` south.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.doc: The wave height: `0.1` to `0.5` gentle, `0.5` to `1` medium, `1` to `2` rough, above `2` a storm.

parameters.name: wavelength
parameters.doc: The distance between wave peaks: `10` to `20` choppy, `20` to `40` ocean waves, above `40` long gentle swells.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.doc: The animation speed: `0.5` to `1` slow, `1` to `3` moderate, `3` to `5` fast, above `5` very fast.

elements.name: get_wave1
elements.brief: Returns the first wave layer's direction, amplitude, wavelength and speed.
elements.description: Returns the first wave layer's direction, amplitude, wavelength and speed.

types: LuaMultiReturn<[ direction: number, amplitude: number, wavelength: number, speed: number ]>

elements.name: set_reflection_params
elements.brief: Sets the cubemap reflection. The reflection samples the cubemap bound to the water
elements.description:
Sets the cubemap reflection. The reflection samples the cubemap bound to the water
material's `reflection_cubemap` sampler; this module binds none.

parameters.name: strength
parameters.doc: The reflection intensity: `0` off, `0.5` moderate, `1` strong.

parameters.name: fresnel_power
parameters.doc:
How much stronger the reflection is at grazing angles, `1` to `5`:
`1` the same at every angle, `3` natural, `5` very strong. Defaults to `3`.

elements.name: get_reflection_params
elements.brief: Returns the reflection strength and fresnel power.
elements.description: Returns the reflection strength and fresnel power.

elements.description: Prints a warning and does nothing else.

parameters.name: cubemap_path
parameters.doc: The cubemap texture path, for example `/main/skybox.cubemap`.

elements.deprecated:
Upstream does not implement cubemap reflections: a cubemap path cannot be
passed to `render.enable_texture`.

elements.name: get_skybox_cubemap
elements.brief: Returns `undefined`.

elements.deprecated:
Upstream does not implement cubemap reflections: a cubemap path cannot be

elements.name: set_lod_params
elements.brief: Sets the level-of-detail distances beyond which effects are simplified.
elements.description: Sets the level-of-detail distances beyond which effects are simplified.

parameters.name: sparkle_distance
parameters.doc: The distance beyond which sparkles are skipped, saving eight texture samples, `0` to `500`. The default is `100`.

parameters.name: foam_distance
parameters.doc: The distance beyond which a simplified foam is drawn, saving three texture samples, `0` to `500`. The default is `150`.

elements.name: get_lod_params
elements.brief: Returns the sparkle and foam level-of-detail distances.
elements.description: Returns the sparkle and foam level-of-detail distances.
